_comment: An external detection-signature pack. Load with --signature-pack (repeatable), or list under signature_packs: in the config file. Its matchers are merged into the built-in catalogues, so they behave exactly like the shipped signatures: header/cookie matches add framework + PHP evidence, body matches run a Go/RE2 regexp over the response. Everything is passive, read-only fingerprinting. On load the pack is bounded and validated (schema, id, <=500 entries per list, <=512-byte regexes that must compile, exact|prefix cookie match); weights are clamped to 0-100. The id@version is stamped into the scan's provenance metadata.
